algorithm: RL-generated Anygrasp-to-Anygrasp transitions used to train a UNet DDPM diffusion foundation controller (DexGen) with gradient-guided diffusion sampling that projects an external (teleoperated) command onto a safe, high-likelihood learned action
headline_metric: real-world success rate (SR) with vs. without DexGen assistance, 2 users
headline_value: Reorient Large(Up): Teleop 0/20 SR vs. Teleop+DexGen 12/20 (75% TTF); Func Grasp: 0/10 vs. 7/10 (87%); Regrasp(Ball): 0/10 vs. 5/10 (78%) (Table I); simulation: 10-100x boost in holding duration for noisy/slow expert policies (Fig. 8)
human_data: none (pretraining dataset is 100% RL rollouts in simulation, not human motion or demonstrations); at deployment a human teleoperator provides the coarse guidance command
note_gaps: the RL reward formula for the underlying Anygrasp-to-Anygrasp primitive policies is not quoted in the parsed sections; Fig. 8's 10-100x simulation boost is qualitative (plot only), no single scalar given
operator_interface: human teleoperator tracked via a Manus Glove (retargeted to the Allegro hand at 300Hz via an unreleased, confidential fast retargeting method) plus a Vive tracker for 6-DoF wrist pose driving the arm
